tree.name: Dò mật khẩu SSH/Hệ thống hoặc tải Wordlist
tree.query: MATCH (ip:IPAddress)-[req:REQUESTED]->(http:HTTPRequest) WHERE (http.uri CONTAINS 'rockyou' OR http.uri CONTAINS 'wordlist' OR http.uri CONTAINS 'htpasswd' OR http.uri CONTAINS 'shadow') AND NOT http.uri CONTAINS 'change_password' WITH ip, http.uri AS wordlist_uri, max(datetime(req.timestamp)) AS time_cracking RETURN ip.ip AS attacker_ip, 'rockyou' AS target_user, 1 AS fails, wordlist_uri, toString(time_cracking) AS time_cracking

on_match.alert_message: 🚨 [MEDIUM] Phát hiện IP {attacker_ip} tải mật khẩu băm ({wordlist_uri}) lúc {time_cracking}

tree.name: Thay đổi Authorized Keys
tree.query: MATCH (p:Process)-[w:WRITE]->(f:File) WHERE f.path CONTAINS '.ssh/authorized_keys' RETURN p.exe AS proc, f.path AS key_file, toString(max(datetime(w.last_seen))) AS time_mod

on_match.alert_message: 🚨 [HIGH] Tiến trình {proc} vừa ghi đè vào file chứa khóa SSH ({key_file}) lúc {time_mod}. Có khả năng Hacker đang cắm rễ (Persistence) để duy trì truy cập!

rule_name: Phát hiện rà quét mạng (Network Port / Host Scan)

tree.name: Nhận diện quét mạng Nmap/TCP Scan
tree.query: MATCH (ip:IPAddress)-[r:RAISED]->(a:Alert) WHERE (a.signature CONTAINS 'SCAN' OR a.signature CONTAINS 'Nmap' OR a.category CONTAINS 'Scan' OR a.signature CONTAINS 'SURICATA SMTP' OR a.signature CONTAINS 'SSLv2') WITH ip, count(a) AS scan_count, max(datetime(r.timestamp)) AS time_scan WHERE scan_count >= 2 RETURN ip.ip AS attacker_ip, scan_count, toString(time_scan) AS time_scan

on_match.alert_message: 🚨 [MEDIUM] Phát hiện hành vi rà quét mạng từ IP {attacker_ip} ({scan_count} dấu hiệu Nmap/Portscan) lúc {time_scan}

rule_name: Phát hiện chung: Tấn công từ chối dịch vụ (DoS/DDoS) qua HTTP

tree.name: Nhận diện Flood Requests
tree.query: MATCH (ip:IPAddress)-[req:REQUESTED]->(http:HTTPRequest) WITH ip, count(req) AS req_count, max(datetime(req.last_seen)) AS last_req WHERE req_count > 5000 RETURN ip.ip AS attacker_ip, req_count, toString(last_req) AS time_ddos

on_match.alert_message: 🚨 [HIGH] DoS/DDoS: IP {attacker_ip} đang tấn công máy chủ với {req_count} HTTP Requests. Lần cuối lúc {time_ddos}

tree.name: Rò rỉ dữ liệu qua DNS
tree.query: MATCH (ip:IPAddress)-[q:QUERIED]->(dns:DNSQuery) WHERE (dns.is_exfiltration = true OR (size(dns.rrname) > 60 AND NOT dns.rrname CONTAINS 'in-addr.arpa')) WITH ip, count(q) AS dns_count, max(datetime(q.last_seen)) AS time_dnsteal WHERE dns_count >= 100 RETURN ip.ip AS attacker_ip, dns_count, toString(time_dnsteal) AS time_dnsteal

on_match.alert_message: 🚨 [CRITICAL] Phát hiện rò rỉ dữ liệu qua DNS từ {attacker_ip} ({dns_count} queries) lúc {time_dnsteal}!

tree.name: Leo thang quyền
tree.query: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RAN_AS]->(p:Process) WHERE (r.is_su = true OR r.is_sudo = true OR r.target_user = 'root') AND NOT u.username IN ['root', '_apt', 'clamav', 'systemd', 'daemon', 'nobody', 'sync', 'ait'] WITH u, max(datetime(r.last_seen)) AS last_privesc RETURN u.username AS user, toString(last_privesc) AS time_privesc

on_match.alert_message: 🚨 [HIGH] Phát hiện leo quyền từ user {user} lúc {time_privesc}!

tree.name: Tắt dịch vụ bảo mật
tree.query: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RAN_AS]->(p:Process) WHERE (p.audit_type = 'SERVICE_STOP' OR p.is_service_event = true OR r.command CONTAINS 'stop' OR r.command CONTAINS 'disable' OR r.command CONTAINS 'kill' OR r.command CONTAINS 'systemctl' OR p.command CONTAINS 'stop' OR p.command CONTAINS 'disable' OR p.command CONTAINS 'kill') AND (p.unit IS NOT NULL OR r.command CONTAINS 'wazuh' OR r.command CONTAINS 'suricata' OR r.command CONTAINS 'audit' OR r.command CONTAINS 'syslog' OR r.command CONTAINS 'filebeat' OR r.command CONTAINS 'ossec' OR r.command CONTAINS 'service' OR p.command CONTAINS 'audit' OR p.command CONTAINS 'suricata') RETURN u.username AS user, coalesce(p.unit, r.command, p.command, p.exe) AS stop_cmd, toString(max(datetime(r.timestamp))) AS time_service_stop

on_match.alert_message: 🚨 [CRITICAL] Tài khoản {user} đã cố gắng tắt dịch vụ bảo mật: {stop_cmd} lúc {time_service_stop}!
